timeline.title: Three triggers behind today's 1% crash
timeline.line: Crude's renewed jump, rising bond yields and rate-hike expectations sank the market
more: Business Standard's explainer cites all three as drivers
US 10-year yield touched 5.36% overnight; the RBI hiked a day earlier
Poor El Niño-linked monsoon rains are adding to price pressures
